svg.text: ROS 2 is not an OS: Ubuntu 26.04 is its Tier 1 platform. Same Ubuntu installer path, plus one offline ROS 2 apt bundle

↑ from Stage 2: ed25519 / ecdsa / rsa keys + IP
→ known_hosts for a verified first connection
TO1 (to1d verified) → TO2 with TPM credential; voucher chain and owner signature verified
← BMO FSIM: UKI (106 MiB, SHA-256 checked)
then chainloads it via LoadImage / StartImage
← the vendor initrd, repacked with the FDO overlay inside
/init /run tmpfs size=50% of RAM (initramfs.runsize=50%; default 10%), room for the bundle; pmem region from memmap=
before 20iso_scan in casper's ORDER file (same hook as the Ubuntu path)
1. modprobe libnvdimm nd_pmem isofs; configure_networking (DHCP); wait for /dev/tpmrm0 and /dev/pmem0 (2.7 GiB)
2. Generate SSH host keys → /run/fdo/ssh-host-keys (Go crypto, no ssh-keygen); capture device IP
3. go-fdo-endpoint: TO1 → TO2 with credential reuse (owner address from the TPM credential's RV info)
→ Credentials FSIM: SSH public keys + IP
← Payload FSIM: full ISO (2.7 GiB) streamed → /dev/pmem0
4. Check the autoinstall arrived and /dev/pmem0 is ISO9660 (else emergency shell)
← = server to device → = device to server
casper-premount/21fdo-ros2-check the ROS 2 bundle is present and a tar archive (else emergency shell, before any install work)
casper-premount/20iso_scan live-media=/dev/pmem0: casper mounts the ISO9660 and the squashfs layers as the live root
casper-bottom/62fdo-autoinstall copies user-data → /autoinstall.yaml in the live root
run-init /run is moved into the live root: autoinstall, SSH host keys and the ROS 2 bundle survive
Subiquity reads /autoinstall.yaml (subiquity.autoinstallpath); storage layout direct → the largest disk
apt mirror pinned to snapshot.ubuntu.com/…/20261002T040000Z: install-time updates are never newer than the bundle
late-commands: FDO SSH host keys → /target/etc/ssh; cloud-init keeps them; NOPASSWD sudo; key-only sshd
late-commands: untar the bundle → /target/var/lib/fdo-ros2; run install-ros2-bundle.sh in the target:
SHA256SUMS → apt-get install from the bundle repo only (own source list + lists dir: no network) → ros2-apt-source
restore archive.ubuntu.com in the target; source /opt/ros/lyrical/setup.bash in ~fdo/.bashrc; marker; poweroff
Installed Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS + ROS 2 Lyrical Luth
ros-base + demo nodes from a pinned snapshot • FDO-provisioned SSH host keys (no TOFU)
Official ROS apt source configured for later updates • Server holds the public keys for verified first SSH
